title: Lineage Is Memory: Parent Inheritance and Feedback Disclosure in Short-Budget LLM-Guided Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2610.41157v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Iterative language-model optimizers refine prompts and programs by evaluating a candidate, showing a proposer model a sample of failing cases, and keeping revisions that improve performance. Recent work attributes the limits of this loop to narrow single-round reflection, introducing full-set error clustering, targeted minibatches, or larger proposer models so the optimizer sees more failure modes per step. Yet every existing evaluation tests these mechanisms exclusively inside lineage-preserving search, where each revision edits a surviving parent, leaving the contribution of parent inheritance confounded with the breadth of per-round feedback. Across 1,750 pre-registered runs spanning nine prompt and program synthesis benchmarks, we separate parent inheritance from feedback disclosure under matched evaluation budgets. translated_title: 谱系即记忆：短预算LLM引导优化中的父代继承与反馈披露
translated_abstract: 迭代式语言模型优化器通过评估候选方案、向提议模型展示失败案例样本、并保留能提升性能的修订来改进提示词和程序。近期研究将这一循环的局限归因于狭窄的单轮反思，为此引入了全集错误聚类、针对性小批量或更大的提议模型，以便优化器在每一步能看到更多失败模式。然而，现有的所有评估都仅在保持谱系的搜索中测试这些机制——即每次修订都编辑一个存活的父代——这使得父代继承的贡献与每轮反馈的广度混淆在一起。在涵盖九个提示词与程序合成基准的1,750次预注册实验中，我们在匹配的评估预算下将父代继承与反馈披露分离开来。研究发现贪婪的父代继承推动了绝大多数优化进展，其表现优于种子重置……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该研究通过1,750次预注册实验首次将父代继承与反馈披露效应分离，发现贪婪的父代继承——即谱系本身充当记忆——才是短预算LLM引导优化中绝大部分进展的真正来源，而非每轮反馈所覆盖的失败模式广度。
